nodes.title: Start of development
nodes.summary: Begin the permitted works within three years of the permission.
nodes.reason_summary: Set the statutory commencement limit under section 91.

nodes.title: Approved drawings and documents
nodes.summary: Carry out the development in line with the listed drawings and documents, including site plan P08, subject to written approvals under other conditions.
nodes.reason_summary: Define the permitted works and secure an acceptable standard.

nodes.title: Planting and replacement
nodes.summary: Implement the approved planting before occupation, to the authority’s written satisfaction. Replace qualifying plant losses or damage within five years of planting.
nodes.reason_summary: Secure green infrastructure and biodiversity gain.

nodes.title: Unexpected contamination
nodes.summary: Report any contamination immediately. When found, obtain approval of investigation, any necessary remediation and verification before occupation.
nodes.reason_summary: Reduce risks from contamination and protect users and the environment.

nodes.title: Highway improvement arrangements
nodes.summary: Obtain written approval of arrangements for the highway improvement works before occupation.

nodes.title: Travel plan
nodes.summary: Implement the approved travel plan in full before occupation and maintain it.
nodes.reason_summary: Protect safe access to and from the site.

nodes.title: Pedestrian and cycle crossing
nodes.summary: Complete the crossing before occupation, following the approved drawing and highway authority specifications.

nodes.title: Car and cycle parking
nodes.summary: Provide the additional car and cycle parking before occupation in line with the approved masterplan.

nodes.title: Drainage design and maintenance
nodes.summary: Develop the site in line with the flood risk and drainage strategy and the drainage operation and maintenance plan.

nodes.title: Drainage verification
nodes.summary: Before occupation, obtain written approval of an independent engineer’s verification of the installed surface-water drainage and the existing system it joins.
nodes.reason_summary: Verify a satisfactory drainage installation and connection.

nodes.title: Community sports use
nodes.summary: Agree community access arrangements with the authority before occupation, after consulting Sport England. Operate the facilities in line with the approved agreement.
nodes.reason_summary: Provide safe, managed community access to sports facilities.

method.pdf_extraction: Page 1, 273 contiguous pure red vector line segments at stroke width 2.76 pt. Join in displayed page coordinates rounded to 0.01 pt.
method.georeferencing: Two-dimensional least-squares similarity transform from eight visually paired building corners to EPSG:27700 using OS OpenMap Local.
method.transform_convention: For the displayed PDF, convert x and y from 54 dpi pixels to points by dividing by 0.75 and negate y. E = origin_e + a*x - b*y. N = origin_n + a*y + b*x.
method.spatial_predicate: Point.within and nearest distance to polygon boundary in metres. Rechecked against the GeoPackage with GDAL SQLite ST_Within and ST_Distance.
method.limit: Controls lie on mapped parts of one school complex. Fit checks show internal consistency and do not establish survey accuracy.
